title: Predatory and useless

title: Payment
body: I got this app because I thought it would be helpful and then once I hit the limit of habits it said I had to pay money. Another thing it says 4+ on the App Store and when it asks what age you are the lowest age is 18 and under so it is definitely not recommended for kids. I’m a teenager who wanted to try this app out but it didn’t even say 16 and under or 13 and under. This is my new most hated app and I’m going to deactivate it.

title: Gets me going
body: I’m the type who writes to-do lists and never looks at them again. But this one actually reminds me at the right time. I’m finally ticking things off every day, and it feels great
author: Shaunta Candyce

title: Finally sticking to it
body: Honestly didn’t expect much, but it’s helped me get out of that rut of ‘meh’ days. Now I feel like I’m actually getting things done . even if it’s just small stuff
author: Potts Darcel

title: Supportive and motivating
body:
I just want to say thank you to the team who built this app. 

One of the features I really appreciate is that you don’t have to complete ALL of your habits to get a “green” day, just MOST of them. I find this motivates me to just do my best every day and I never feel guilted or pressured like some other habit tracking apps I’ve tried lol.

Keep up the great work!
author: ali167845609833

title: Bad app
body: I couldn’t even get to the app. It kept asking me irrelevant questions that I didn’t want to answer. Like what time do I wake up. Well it’s different every day. I do shift work and that’s not an option. I wanted to create my own routine not have you suggest one for me. Hence the name of your app. MY routine not your routine.
author: Volcanic126

title: Love it but kinda overstimulating
body: I love this app so much and its cute but i find it very overstimulating and overwhelming, i just think that maybe more default tasks could be added because i found it confusing and stressful to navigate. Like Brushing Teeth, doing hair, getting dressed etc I understand you can add them but i just find the app a little overwhelming to look at and use but otherwise its helpful 💞💞💞
